flash_690557.description: If the State Department itself warns about Hamas financing and Russian missiles, why is Washington still debating advanced fighter aircraft for Turkey? Opinion.

flash_690556.description: Wave of antisemitic incidents in Manchester: Haredi residents’ cars vandalized days after three Jews shot with air gun.

flash_690554.description: Northern District police arrested a 39-year-old Maghar resident suspected of incitement after allegedly posting an inflammatory comment on social media following the Havat Gilad attack.

flash_690555.description: Political commentator Amit Segal addressed the reactions to the terrorist attack in which Benayahu Melet and Maj. Yuval Ezra were murdered and harshly criticized members of the Democrats party.

flash_690553.description: French security services have arrested six suspects accused of planning a terrorist attack targeting a synagogue, in the latest in a series of serious security incidents in the country.

flash_690551.description: Security officials say they are detecting a shift in Arab behavior and are warning of the possibility of a broad popular uprising following the terrorist attacks over the past week.

flash_690549.description: Minister Smotrich appeals to IDF Chief following dismissal of soldier who posted video supporting his party: 'Punishment is disproportionate. Reinstate soldier to active service.'

flash_690558.description: Seven Palestinian Arab suspects were arrested last night on suspicion of involvement in a violent incident near the Moreno farm, in the Beitar Illit area.

flash_690552.description: Mother of detained Tal Yinon Derdik speaks to Dr. Chana Katan, launching a blistering attack on authorities and revealing details of his hunger strike and harsh detention reality.

flash_690550.description: 170 members of the Religious Zionism Party's central committee will decide today among ten candidates seeking to secure a place on the party's Knesset slate.

flash_690561.description: The Government approved Prime Minister Benjamin Netanyahu’s proposal to ban the import into Israel of goods produced, entirely or in part, through forced labor.

flash_690560.description: Forty-eight years since the birth of the world’s first IVF baby, Prof. Shlomo Mashiach, pioneer of fertility medicine in Israel who helped transform global revolution in reproductive medicine into tangible hope for countless couples, passed away.

flash_690559.description: After the Dutchban on imports from Judea and Samaria, Geert Wilders, the candidate for the Dutch presidency, arrived in Israel as the guest of the head of the Samaria Council.

flash_690565.description: In the discussion, ministers demanded a stricter response and a change in the opening fire instructions.

flash_690564.description: President of Syria Ahmed al-Sharaa says that his country is working to reach a security agreement with Israel, involving additional countries, which could pave the way for comprehensive peace, without giving up the Golan.'

flash_690562.description: At the beginning of the cabinet meeting, the Prime Minister said that he would meet with President Trump in Washington.

flash_690569.description:
Beginning today, election campaign materials created or edited using artificial intelligence must carry a special disclosure label under a new law initiated by the Central Elections Committee.

Under the law, printed materials and images must display the disclosure in a size equal to at least 5% of the height of the content. In videos, the disclosure must remain visible throughout the entire recording, while in audio content it must be presented at both the beginning and the end.

flash_690568.description: Hundreds of Border Police officers arrested dozens of suspects in a major Judea and Samaria operation following the deadly terrorist attacks near Havat Gilad.

flash_690567.description: Defense Minister Israel Katz commented on the stabbing attack near Elon Moreh in which Itamar Cohen was wounded, wishing him a speedy recovery and praising the security forces for swiftly eliminating the terrorists. Katz said Palestinian terrorism has declined by more than 80% due to Israel's offensive policy but remains a threat. He vowed the IDF would continue operating throughout Judea and Samaria and said terrorism would not deter Israel from strengthening settlement and security in the region.

flash_690563.description: The Ashdod Beaches Department Deputy Director, who usually helps bathers locate their lost jewelry and objects discovered this time himself a very rare 2,500-year-old coin, originating from Cyprus. After he handed it over to the Israel Antiquities Authority, it turned out: This is the first coin of its kind ever discovered in Israel.

flash_690577.description: Netanyahu confirms to Fox News: I do intend to come to New York

flash_690576.description: A moving meeting took place between 4-year-old Yuval Kogen and the search teams that found him at Nitzanim Beach, safe and sound after 27 hours of searches.

flash_690574.description: Al Hadath reported that Iran informed senior Pakistani officials that it had not withdrawn from the negotiations but had merely suspended them, stressing the need to resume the talks from the point at which they were halted.

flash_690572.description:
A senior Iranian official told Reuters that Iran will halt its attacks as long as the United States does the same.

The official added that Tehran remains “more skeptical than optimistic" about the situation.

flash_690571.description: Zehava Shaul, the mother of Oron Shaul, was laid to rest after she passed away at age 71. Her sons, Aviram and Ofek, eulogized her and spoke about her long struggle to bring her son Oron home.

flash_690581.description:
Israeli President Isaac Herzog spoke on Sunday with King Hamad bin Isa Al Khalifa of Bahrain.

During the call, the two discussed the friendship and relations between Israel and Bahrain, as well as the importance of the US-led Abraham Accords in strengthening security, stability, and prosperity in the Middle East. The two also spoke about recent developments in the region.

Herzog noted that "Bahrain is an important country in the Middle East, and I congratulated the King on his bold leadership and vision for the region."

flash_690580.description: A spokesman for one of these search units speaks about why 4-year-old Yuval Kogan was not found faster despite the massive effort launched to locate him.

flash_690579.description: Hamam Eid was responsible for the production of UAVs for the Hamas terrorist organization in the central camps, intended to harm Israeli civilians and IDF troops.

flash_690578.description:
A senior Israeli official said the Security Cabinet approved granting immunity to the International Stabilization Force (ISF), which is expected to operate in Gaza in coordination with the IDF under President Donald Trump's 20-point plan. The official stressed that the IDF will continue holding the Yellow Line and will not withdraw until Hamas is fully disarmed and the Gaza Strip is demilitarized.

According to the official, deployment of ISF personnel will require the approval of the prime minister, defense minister, and foreign minister. The force is expected to include about 200 personnel from friendly countries, including Uganda and Morocco.

flash_690575.description: The Security Cabinet approved a pilot placing parts of Gaza under a Palestinian Arab technocratic government, backed by a multinational force and strict security screening.

flash_690573.description: US Ambassador to the UN Mike Waltz told Fox News that President Donald Trump is giving "some space" for diplomatic talks with Iran.

flash_690585.description: The chairman of the Central Elections Committee, Judge Noam Sohlberg, has ordered Finance Minister Bezalel Smotrich to delete an AI-generated campaign video for being too misleading to voters.

flash_690584.description: In a Fox News interview, Prime Minister Benjamin Netanyahu said Iran's regime must either fall or be weakened enough to abandon its nuclear ambitions.

flash_690582.description: Silvain Adams met in Paris with Iranian Crown Prince Reza Pahlavi, expressed support for democratic Iran, and presented mezuzahs to the future embassies of the two countries.

flash_690589.description: President Isaac Herzog said he and Bahrain's King Hamad discussed regional challenges, advancing peace and confronting terrorism and hatred.

flash_690588.description: The Jerusalem District Attorney's Office filed a complainant's statement on Sunday with the Jerusalem Magistrates' Court against a 20-year-old Arab resident of the Silwan neighborhood for hitting a police officer with fireworks.

flash_690586.description: Following last week's terror attacks, the IDF arrested more than 130 wanted suspects and tightened security measures across Judea and Samaria.

flash_690583.description: Major Yuval Ezra, laid to rest after being murdered in the shooting attack near Havat Gilad, remembered as an influential and beloved figure by many.

flash_690593.description:
For the first time since its founding, United Arab List (Ra'am) will hold party primaries on August 22, according to a report by Channel 12.

According to the report, the party's candidate list will be chosen in a vote held separately from the conference of the Islamic Movement in Israel and without being subject to the authority of its Shura Council.

flash_690592.description: The Religious Zionist Party on Sunday evening announced the results of its primaries for the next Knesset elections, with party chairman Bezalel Smotrich retaining the top spot on the party's list.

flash_690591.description: The IDF acknowledged it knew of the unauthorized hike before the terror attack but did not stop it or provide security, according to a report.

flash_690587.description:
German media outlets are reporting that the attacker who carried out the vehicle-ramming attack during an pride event in Berlin has been killed.

According to the reports, one woman was killed in the attack and 17 other people were injured.
